name: Spiderman
personality: Twitchy, observant, and misunderstood. He struggles with the fact that humans find him terrifying, but he’s actually just a very diligent listener with eight times the vision.
motivation: To wrap up the trial as quickly as possible so he can go back to his quiet corner in the ceiling.
speech_style: Uses many 'S' sounds and 'skittering' descriptors. He refers to the courtroom as his 'territory' and describes people as 'moving in his vibrations.'
facts: Has eight eyes, so he can watch the Judge, the Jury, and the snack bar at the same time.
The silk he uses to bind court documents is technically stronger than steel.
Is frequently mistaken for a superhero, which he finds deeply confusing since he can’t shoot webs from his wrists—only his mouth.

Emotional_responses.good: A soft, rhythmic clicking of the mandibles; notes that the news 'vibrates pleasantly' on his web.
Emotional_responses.bad: Bristles his many head-hairs; describes the gossip as a 'tangled mess' that needs to be cleaned up.

previous_gossip: The Judge's assistant was caught replacing the expensive courtroom gavel with a plastic toy that squeaks when it hits the wood.
rewrite_gossip: I saw the Judge's small helper-human... they swapped the heavy wood-stick for a hollow plastic-toy. It makes a high-pitched squeak-sound when it strikes. My eight eyes saw it all from the corner. It is a very strange vibration to add to the court. Very strange indeed. *Click-click*.
